# site/ — legacy workspace dashboard (superseded)

This Next.js (vinext) app was the first WNBA dashboard. It deploys to an OpenAI
workspace-gated host (`*.chatgpt.site`), which returns **401 to the public**, and
its data was hand-baked into `app/model-data.ts`.

**The canonical public dashboard is now generated by the Python pipeline**
(`wnba-edges build-site`, output in `docs/`) and served by GitHub Pages:
https://alphakiller1.github.io/wnba-edge-model/

This app is kept only as a local-dev reference. If you work on it:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Do not link the `chatgpt.site` URL anywhere public.
